## 1. Root `.rstp` Manifest Grammar
Uses the RaggieSoft Studio comment-preserving `[Section]` syntax (`;` comments and `@include "shared.rsti"` directives survive AST edits byte-for-byte):

```ini
; Mandatory root course identity
[Course]

[Compliance]
```

## 2. Slide Markdown Directives
- **Timed DOM Callouts**: `:::cue MM:SS.mmm | Callout Heading` ... `:::`
- **Knowledge Checks**: `:::question <id> | <Prompt>` with `- [ ] id | Choice`, `- [x] id | Correct Choice`, `pass:`, `retry:`, closed by `:::`.
- **Formal Attestation**: `:::attestation` with `statement:`, `checkbox:`, `button:`, closed by `:::`.
- **Explicit Alt Metadata**: `![Descriptive alt](img.svg)` or `![](divider.svg){decorative=true}` (omitting both fails `RST014`).
